name: Unthrottled Timers & Whisper SpeechRecognition

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://api.groq.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
